biggest_catch: The $100 requires a real recurring payroll direct deposit of $200+ within 45 days — casual transfers don't qualify — and each referrer is capped at $1,000/year in rewards.
catches: You must sign up through a referral link or code; the $200+ in eligible recurring payroll deposits must land within 45 days of account opening.
'Eligible recurring payroll' means employer payroll — not bank-to-bank transfers, Zelle, or one-off deposits.
Referral rewards are capped at $1,000 per referrer per year.
The $100 is paid within 10 business days after you qualify — not on signup day.

A separate limited-time $200 offer ran 9/17/2026–10/1/2026 (https://current.com/lto-200-200-referral-offer-2609/) requiring $1,500+ in payroll deposits within 35 days — it expires 10/1/2026 and is the stricter, expiring variant; the route is verified on the standard $100 program.

steps: Sign up for a Current account using a referral link or code — https://dotcom.current.com/referral_program_terms_and_conditions/ states the $100 terms.
Get approved and open your account; note your account-opening date — the 45-day payroll window runs from it.
Route at least $200 in eligible recurring payroll direct deposits (employer paycheck, not bank-to-bank transfers) into the account within 45 days of account opening.
Keep the account in good standing; the $100 referral reward is paid within 10 business days after you qualify.
